name: [🚨UPDATE] Eagle Nation
desc:
🇺🇸 Eagle Nation - Motorcycle Open World 

🔥 Ride through every road be it dense forests, deserts, mountains, coastlines, with your very own motorcycle, save up and purchase more bikes, Socialize in hangout spots, and play together with your brotherhood! 🔥

⚠️ Game is still in beta testing. there will be several bugs related to data & gameplay.
You can claim your lost data ( MOTORCYCLE & CASH ) through our communications. open a ticket.
Stay tuned for updates, join our community to express your suggestions!

🕹️ Keybinds:

W / S - Accelerate & Brake
A / D - Steering
T - Wheelie
V + B - First Person
Hold B + W - Burnout 🔥
Shift ( On foot ) - Run
Shift ( On Vehicle ) - Parking Brake
FreeCam - Shift + P

👷🏻‍♂️ Credits to:
TechnoHarvard & Dupleh - Game Creator
